grammar.title: 语法知识 反身代词
lines: 3 英语中为什么有反身代词？ 反身代词的用法
人称 主格代词 反身代词 主格代词 反身代词
单数 复数
第一人称 I my self we our selves
第二人称 you your self you your selves
第三人称 he him self they them selves
she her self
it it self
强调 主语&宾语 不言而喻的宾语
He himself sent me a gift. 他 亲自 送我一件礼物。 I see Obama himself . 我见了奥巴马 本人 。 Take good care of yourself . Enjoy yourself .
介词 + 反身代词 动词 + 反身代词
by oneself 独自、依靠自己 enjoy oneself 玩的开心、过的愉快
I’m going to swim by myself. He’s going to learn English by himself. They always enjoy themselves. Come on, enjoy yourself, let yourself go!
between oneself 私 下 help oneself 随意
It’s just between ourselves. Help yourselves, please.

expand.title: 扩展知识 时间与介词的搭配
lines: 3 需加介词的情况 (表示“时间”是“名词”时就需要加上相应的介词) Where do you come from? I come from France. § 不需用介词的情况 (表示“时间”是“副词”时不需要加介词) 副词 无需介词的情况：today \ tomorrow \ yesterday \ this… \ that… \ next… \ last… 每日习语 Your guess is as good as mine 我也不知道；我也在纳闷
at + 点 (具体时间点) on + 天 (某一天) in + 月、季、年 (较宽泛的时间范围)

I often meet him at ten o’clock . I’m going to arrive at 10:00 on Friday . I am going to see him at ten o’clock . His birthday is on May 1st. She must get up early on Monday . Invited me to dinner on my birthday . They come back in May . It’s cold in winter and hot in summer. It often rains in November.
I always go to work in the morning.
What is the climate like in your country?
It’s cold in winter and hot in summer.
It’s sunny today .
I’m going to meet some friends tomorrow .
He is going to go abroad next year.
He is free this month.
